create_GMDataLoader: create a GMDataLoader instance from a list or dict of TimeSeriesData objects for global model batching
get_batch_GMDataLoader: get a batch of time series IDs by calling get_batch with a specified batch size on GMDataLoader
create_GMBatch: create a GMBatch from GMParam and batch IDs to compute training and validation indices and tensors
get_features_GMBatch: get time series features as a torch Tensor by calling get_features with start and end indices on GMBatch
review_GMBatch_get_indices: review the GMBatch _get_indices method to understand how training and validation indices are computed for batching
